hooks.name: Notice Action Extractor
hooks.description: Extracts deadlines and actionable tasks from new college notices

action.prompt: Read the notice from the newly created file in `notices/raw/`. Extract what changed, who is affected, key deadlines, and a required action checklist according to `.kiro/steering/extractor-rules.md`. Write the formatted output directly into a new markdown file inside `notices/extracted/` with the file suffix `-checklist.md`.
